applied.quote: At ModernWallet, we review loan rules and tax provisions to show the direct mechanics of debt repayment.
applied.why: Site self-description does not license this first-person claim.

applied.quote: Because the canceled debt counts as income in a single year, borrowers carrying private loans without forgiveness provisions often evaluate alternative options.
applied.why: SOURCE does not state what borrowers with private loans typically do or evaluate.

applied.quote: If total liabilities exceed total assets by $10,000, up to $10,000 of canceled debt can be excluded from income.
applied.replacement: If total liabilities exceed total assets, up to that excess amount of canceled debt can be excluded from income.

applied.quote: State revenue departments establish individual tax codes that do not automatically adopt every federal exclusion or reporting requirement.
Some states follow the federal gross income definitions under the Internal Revenue Code, while others apply state-specific rules to canceled debt.

Borrowers receiving debt cancellations should examine their state revenue department instructions to identify local filing rules for discharged debt.
applied.replacement: Borrowers should check their state's rules.

applied.quote: Evaluating borrowing caps early helps minimize the size of future taxable cancellations.
applied.why: SOURCE does not mention borrowing caps or their effects.
